naturality.config.effects.hotbarOffset.t: Move the hotbar and its HUD elements (health, hunger, armor, air, XP and mount bars) upward together by 0â€“10 pixels. Default: 3.
naturality.config.effects.elasticHands.t: Apply elastic easing as swings and item-use poses return to rest.
naturality.config.effects.elasticHandsSp: Higher values settle faster. 100% uses the original speed.
naturality.config.effects.elasticHandsSt: Overshoot strength. 0% removes overshoot; 100% uses the original strength.
naturality.config.effects.distantWind.to: Fade foliage wind between 64 and 96 horizontal blocks, then skip its vertex calculations. Nearby wind remains unchanged.
Beyond 160 blocks, make ordinary leaf cubes opaque and remove shared internal faces. Full detail returns within 128 blocks. Distant foliage becomes denser; nearby leaves retain their appearance.
naturality.config.effects.distantTexture: Smoothly blend static textures into their average color from 160 to 224 blocks (10-14 chunks). The fade follows the camera without texture-driven chunk rebuilds. Transparent masks, biome tint and lighting are preserved. Animated and translucent effects retain their textures.
naturality.config.effects.distantDetails: Beyond 192 blocks (12 chunks), hide decorative grass, ferns and flowers and skip custom snow texture overlays. These details return within 160 blocks. Snow layer geometry, crops, trees and world blocks remain.
naturality.config.gameplay.sleepAccelera: Sleep at any time, even near monsters. Gradually accelerates day/night time and visual effects while world simulation stays at its normal rate. Respects the sleeping-percentage gamerule. Rest resets after more than 6,000 accelerated time ticks asleep. Sounds ease into muffling while asleep, and sky rotation and cloud drift are smoothed. OFF restores vanilla sleep.
naturality.config.gameplay.sleepMaxSpeed: Maximum day/night and visual speed, from 1Ã— to 1000Ã—. Entity AI, block updates and weather simulation keep their normal tick rate. Particle velocity, fire animation and clouds follow the visual speed; particle spawning and lifetimes stay normal. The default is 200Ã—. All dimensions and awake players share the accelerated day/night time. Waking stops acceleration immediately when the sleeping requirement is no longer met.
naturality.config.gameplay.sleepRampSeco: Seconds spent asleep before reaching maximum speed. The ramp restarts when too few players remain asleep.
naturality.config.epilepsyMode.tooltip: Suppresses and eases flashing lights, rapid color changes and strobe effects. OFF restores all effects.
naturality.config.liquids.waterDepth.too: Clear nearby scenery becomes a biome-colored silhouette before fading into water fog. Underwater lighting brightens gradually while preserving shaded caves for terrain, entities and particles. Swamps remain murky.
naturality.config.liquids.waterDistortio: World-aligned refraction above water grows with depth. Coarse underwater distortion fades out nearby.
naturality.config.liquids.waterShimmer.t: Project lightly biome-tinted highlights onto exposed seafloor tops, from shallow water to deep seabeds. Fades with weather.
naturality.config.liquids.water.tooltip: Use live procedural textures for still and flowing water. OFF restores the active resource pack's water sprites. Applies immediately.
naturality.config.liquids.lava.tooltip: Use live procedural lava textures. OFF restores both lava sprites from the active resource pack. Applies immediately.
naturality.config.liquids.flowingLava.to: Use the directional procedural sprite for flowing lava when Lava changes is ON. OFF uses the active resource pack's flowing lava sprite while keeping custom still lava.
naturality.config.hardcoreDarkness.caves: Master toggle for removing ambient light and darkening cave fog in enabled dimensions. OFF restores normal ambient lighting. Independent of moon darkness. Default: ON.
Normal ambient light retained in enabled dimensions: 0% makes unlit caves pitch black; 100% keeps normal ambient light. Torches and night vision still work. Default: 0%.
Fade cave haze with local light so fog does not reveal dark terrain. Follows retained ambient light in enabled dimensions; excludes lava and powder snow. Default: ON.
naturality.config.hardcoreDarkness.dimen: Enable this page's darkness effect in the Overworld. Default: ON.
Enable this page's darkness effect in the Nether. Moon darkness uses the Overworld day and moon cycle where there is no moving sun. Default: OFF.
Enable this page's darkness effect in the End. Moon darkness uses the Overworld day and moon cycle where there is no moving sun. Default: OFF.
Enable this page's darkness effect in custom dimensions. Uses their sun/moon when available, otherwise the Overworld cycle. Default: OFF.
Master toggle for moon-dependent skylight, sky and cloud darkening. OFF restores normal moon-independent brightness, without changing cave darkness. Default: ON.
Night skylight retained during a full moon. 0% is no moonlight; 100% is normal night skylight. Does not dim the moon or stars. Default: 100%.
Night skylight retained for waxing and waning gibbous moons. Also scales sky/clouds when their toggles are ON. Default: 75%.
Night skylight retained for first and third quarter moons. Also scales sky/clouds when their toggles are ON. Default: 50%.
Night skylight retained for waxing and waning crescent moons. Also scales sky/clouds when their toggles are ON. Default: 25%.
Night skylight retained during a new moon. At 0%, enable Cave darkness with 0% ambient light for pitch-black unlit terrain. Moon and stars retain normal brightness. Default: 0%.
Apply phase brightness to the sky background and horizon fog. The sun, moon and stars keep their normal brightness. Default: ON.
Apply phase brightness to both Naturality cloud layers and vanilla clouds. Daylight remains unchanged. Default: ON.
naturality.config.dynamicLighting.subBlo: Keep fractional hand/entity positions with 1/16-light-level precision. Respects walls and the existing surface pixel grid. Costs more CPU work; OFF restores block-snapped sources. Default: ON.
naturality.config.dynamicLighting.enable: Moving light sources illuminate the client world. Disabling removes their light. Does not affect server gameplay or mob spawning.
naturality.config.dynamicLighting.update: 50-1000 ms at 20 ticks/second. Lower values follow movement faster but require more lighting and chunk updates. Default: 100 ms.
naturality.config.dynamicLighting.bright: Scales emitted light levels; capped at Minecraft's maximum level 15. Default: 100%.
naturality.config.dynamicLighting.source: Only track sources within this distance from the camera. This is a performance limit, not each light's radius. Default: 48 blocks.
naturality.config.dynamicLighting.maxSou: Track the nearest light source cells first. Lower this if moving lights cause chunk rebuild stutter. Default: 64.
naturality.config.dynamicLighting.heldIt: Light-emitting items in either hand of players and mobs illuminate nearby blocks, starting near the hand.
naturality.config.dynamicLighting.emissi: Blazes, glow squid, magma cubes, allays, vexes, wardens, glow frames and faint emissive eyes. Entity light levels can be customized by ID in the JSON config.
naturality.config.dynamicLighting.burnin: Entities on fire emit level 15 light.
naturality.config.dynamicLighting.droppe: Dropped torches, lanterns and other supported luminous items emit light until picked up or removed.
naturality.config.title: Naturality settings
naturality.config.reset.tooltip: Reset this setting to its default value.
naturality.config.fog.enabled.tooltip: OFF restores vanilla fog. ON enables pixelated borders, an End sky fade and an Overworld atmosphere fade that hides the sun, moon and stars behind terrain. Applies when leaving this page.
naturality.config.fog.pixelSize.tooltip: Size in screen pixels, from 1Ã—1 to 32Ã—32. Smaller means finer resolution; larger means chunkier squares. Default: 4Ã—4. Applies when leaving this page.
naturality.config.lighting.darkStep.tool: Approximate brightness gap in deep shadows. Smaller values give finer bands. Range: 0.1â€“10%. Applies on closing settings.
naturality.config.lighting.lightStep.too: Approximate brightness gap near full light. Range: 0.1â€“10%. Cannot be lower than the dark step; equal values give uniform steps.
naturality.config.lighting.aoStep.toolti: Independent AO shading gap. Range: 0.1â€“5%. Default: 0.5%. The block grid stays 16Ã—16.
naturality.config.lighting.darkSaturatio: Maximum extra saturation as lighting darkens. 0% disables the boost. Default: 100%.
naturality.config.lighting.saturationSta: Lighting level below which the saturation boost smoothly eases in. Default: 30%. Higher values include brighter areas.
naturality.config.lighting.saturationFul: Lighting level at which the full boost is reached. Default: 10%. Must remain at least 1% below the start level; adjusted when saved.
naturality.config.intro.tooltip: Controls new portal openings in your singleplayer/LAN worlds. OFF restores instant ignition; physical crossing still controls travel. Remote servers control this in naturality-server.json. Openings already in progress finish normally.
naturality.config.clouds.enabled.tooltip: Two customizable cloud layers. Off restores vanilla clouds. Minecraft Clouds: Off still hides all clouds.
naturality.config.clouds.base.style.tool: With fading enabled, volumetric clouds adapt their caps and gradient to camera height. Without fading, Open shell has no lid and Solid keeps both caps. Flat has no sides.
naturality.config.clouds.base.fadingSide: Adapt the pixel gradient and top/bottom caps to camera height, with uniform face color. Day/night tint remains. Off restores directional shading. Flat is unaffected.
naturality.config.clouds.base.width.tool: Width in blocks of each cloud texture cell. Default: 12.
Cloud thickness in blocks. Has no effect on Flat style.
naturality.config.clouds.base.heightOffs: Blocks above or below the dimension's normal cloud height. Upper layer defaults to +40.
naturality.config.clouds.base.fadePixels: Number of square pixel rows along the side. Fewer rows make larger pixels.
naturality.config.clouds.base.speedPerce: 100% = vanilla speed; 0 = stationary; negative values reverse direction.
naturality.config.clouds.upper.style.too: With fading enabled, volumetric clouds adapt their caps and gradient to camera height. Without fading, Open shell has no lid and Solid keeps both caps. Flat has no sides.
naturality.config.clouds.upper.fadingSid: Adapt the pixel gradient and top/bottom caps to camera height, with uniform face color. Day/night tint remains. Off restores directional shading. Flat is unaffected.
naturality.config.clouds.upper.width.too: Width in blocks of each cloud texture cell. Default: 12.
naturality.config.clouds.upper.thickness: Cloud thickness in blocks. Has no effect on Flat style.
naturality.config.clouds.upper.heightOff: Blocks above or below the dimension's normal cloud height. Upper layer defaults to +40.
naturality.config.clouds.upper.fadePixel: Number of square pixel rows along the side. Fewer rows make larger pixels.
naturality.config.clouds.upper.speedPerc: 100% = vanilla speed; 0 = stationary; negative values reverse direction.
naturality.config.effects.cameraFlare.to: Show pixelated square lens flares from the on-screen sun. Independent of Sun beams. Brightens when looking directly at the sun.
naturality.config.effects.glassShineOpac: Overall glass shine opacity, from 0% to 100%. 100% preserves the original maximum; 0% hides the shine. Default: 100%.
naturality.config.effects.cameraFlareMax: Maximum camera flare opacity, from 0% to 100%. Viewing angle, weather and each sprite's shading reduce it further. Default: 14%.
naturality.config.search.tooltip: Filter estimated FPS impact with #Low, #Medium, #High or #ExtraHigh (#Extra High also works). Add words to narrow results, e.g. #High heat. Multiple tags match either tier. Tags ignore capitalization and include only rated settings, whether ON or OFF.
naturality.config.lighting.enabled.toolt: Enable the terrain lighting grid, brightness bands and shadow saturation. Applies when leaving this screen.
naturality.config.fog.densitySteps.toolt: Number of density bands in pixel fog (2â€“64). Applies when leaving this screen.
naturality.config.effects.sunBeams.toolt: Show rotating pixelated rays around the sun. Independent of Camera flare.
naturality.config.effects.starPulses.too: Animate star brightness and size. Off keeps static stars. Applies when leaving this screen.
naturality.config.effects.auroraSegments: Number of flat planes used for each 256-block aurora curve span. Lower values create a more angular, low-poly aurora.
naturality.config.effects.smoke.tooltip: Use swirling, expanding smoke. Off uses vanilla motion for new particles; resource-pack sprites remain.
naturality.config.effects.flames.tooltip: Use upright, constant-size animated flames. Off uses vanilla behavior for new particles; resource-pack sprites remain.
naturality.config.effects.leaves.tooltip: Use world-oriented falling leaves that rest on surfaces. Off restores vanilla leaf behavior.
Time on the ground before a ten-tick fade. 20 ticks = 1 second. Requires tumbling and resting leaves.
Vary animation by position and join connected wall textures. Off uses the original repeating exemplar animation on fitted surfaces. Applies when leaving this screen.
Join adjacent wall-fire textures. Requires fire texture variation. Applies when leaving this screen. Surface fitting and server contact behavior are unchanged.
naturality.config.portal.endParallax.too: Show spatial star layers behind End portals. Off restores projected layers. Applies when leaving this screen.
naturality.config.portal.endWalls.toolti: Fade neighboring block textures into End portal openings.
naturality.config.portal.endGlow.tooltip: Show End portal glow strips. Also requires Glow effect.
naturality.config.portal.eyeGlow.tooltip: Replace the insertion smoke puff with a fading glow. Off restores the puff.
naturality.config.portal.suppressEndSmok: Suppress ambient smoke from active End portals.
naturality.config.liquids.waterRim.toolt: Show a pixel rim around models crossing water and cauldron surfaces. Requires Water changes.
naturality.config.liquids.rainRipples.to: Show rain impact rings on exposed water and cauldrons. Requires Water changes.
naturality.config.liquids.waterfallParti: Small and large spray where falling or sloping water reaches flat resting water. Requires Water changes.
naturality.config.liquids.dripRipples.to: Show rings where falling water particles land. Requires Water changes.
naturality.config.fog.borderStartPercent: Fog density where pixelation starts. Must stay below full strength; clamped on save.
Fog density where pixelation reaches full strength. Must stay above the start; clamped on save.
Fit fire visuals, selection and burn contact to supporting shapes, allowing partial supports. Off restores vanilla geometry and placement. Server-owned; synced to connected clients.
naturality.config.gameplay.vanillaPortal: On restores vanilla portal waiting time, arrival, cooldown and entry overlay. Off uses physical crossing. Portal intro remains independent. Server-owned; synced to connected clients.
naturality.config.effects.snowOverlays.t: Add snow-colored patches to covered support faces. Requires the server to enable Snow wrapping.
naturality.config.effects.weatherParticl: Replace vanilla precipitation sheets with particle clusters.
naturality.config.effects.foliageWind.to: Animate exposed foliage in the wind and brush vertically connected non-solid plants aside on contact with players and other entities, with flexible hanging strands and water-damped underwater plants.
naturality.config.effects.particleWind.t: Let wind move exposed smoke, leaves and other eligible particles.
naturality.config.effects.windSounds.too: Play weak and strong wind ambience.
naturality.config.effects.pixelGlint.too: Use the animated pixel grid instead of the vanilla glint texture.
naturality.config.effects.worldGlintCont: Outline enchanted world items, item frames and equipment on living entities.
naturality.config.effects.handGlintConto: Outline enchanted items in first-person hands.
naturality.config.effects.previewGlintCo: Outline enchanted equipment in inventory player portraits.
Fit snow placement, collision and selection to supporting shapes. Off restores vanilla snow behavior. Controlled by the server.
naturality.config.gameplay.snowCompactio: Walking and landing compress snow layers, preserving the last layer. Controlled by the server.
naturality.config.gameplay.weatherThaw.t: Warm weather gradually melts exposed snow and ice. Off keeps vanilla melting rules. Controlled by the server.
naturality.config.gameplay.weatherSnowAc: Use rain strength to set natural snow accumulation limits. Off uses the vanilla gamerule. Controlled by the server.
naturality.config.liquids.waterParticleT: Tint water droplets, bubbles and splashes using the local biome. Requires Water changes.
naturality.config.liquids.waterWake.tool: Keep a short wake behind moving entities. Requires Water rims.
naturality.config.liquids.waterImpactCol: Show a splash column when entities fall more than five blocks into water.
naturality.config.liquids.waterSplashSou: Play the added splash sound for large falls into water.
naturality.config.liquids.lavaRim.toolti: Draw a rim where entities meet the lava surface.
naturality.config.liquids.lavaWake.toolt: Keep a short wake behind moving entities. Requires Lava rims.
naturality.config.liquids.lavaRainRipple: Show small smoke where rain hits lava.
naturality.config.liquids.lavaDripRipple: Show rings where droplets hit lava.
naturality.config.liquids.lavafallPartic: Show spray and droplets around falling lava.
naturality.config.liquids.lavaImpactColu: Show a splash column when entities fall into lava.
naturality.config.liquids.waterFallDropl: Show ballistic droplets at the foot of waterfalls. Requires Waterfall particles.
naturality.config.liquids.lavaFallDrople: Show ballistic droplets at the foot of lavafalls. Requires Lavafall spray.
naturality.config.effects.floatingLeaves: Let falling leaves rest and drift on water. Requires Leaf changes.
naturality.config.effects.rainSplashFade: Fade ground rain droplets before they land.
naturality.config.effects.bubblePops.too: Play a bubble-pop animation when bubble particles expire.
naturality.config.effects.fixedBubbleSca: Give bubble sprite variants a consistent pixel scale. Off restores vanilla random sizing.
naturality.config.liquids.emissiveLava.t: Keep lava sides as bright as the top, bypassing environmental shading.
naturality.config.clouds.base.opacityPer: Base cloud opacity, from 0% (hidden) to 100% (opaque). Side gradients, camera-height transitions and distance fading still apply. Default: 100%.
naturality.config.clouds.upper.opacityPe: Base cloud opacity, from 0% (hidden) to 100% (opaque). Side gradients, camera-height transitions and distance fading still apply. Default: 100%.
naturality.config.presets.description: Apply a preset, then customize any setting.
naturality.config.presets.editable: Presets replace settings; individual edits remain yours.
naturality.config.presets.titleOnly: Apply presets from the title screen.
naturality.config.restart.settings: Startup settings - restart Minecraft after changing.
naturality.config.restart.required: Restart Minecraft to finish applying these settings.
naturality.config.restart.tooltip: Requires restarting Minecraft. Changes affect this installation.
naturality.config.preset.default.tooltip: Restore all current shipped defaults, including numeric values and normally disabled options.
naturality.config.preset.clientside_only: Restore locally derived client visuals. Disable added content, gameplay changes, custom menus, server networking and changes to vanilla block/entity data. Restart to apply strict client-only mode.
naturality.config.preset.no_visual_overh: Keep content and gameplay with optional visuals and ambience off, including heat waves, lens flare and mob-death effects. Restore vanilla portal entry, fire/snow shapes and ghast deaths; disable broadcasts used only by visual impacts. Restart to finish applying.
naturality.config.feature.content.toolti: Register Naturality blocks, items, status effects and custom entities, with their recipes and world data. Enable before opening worlds that contain this content.
naturality.config.feature.nether_terrain: Vary Nether lava lake heights in new chunks, with sealed basin beds, scattered crust and connected lavafalls. Keeps vanilla cavern terrain. Requires restart.
Generate deeper offshore oceans with broad beach shelves and large, smoothly blended vanilla, paths, spires, cracks and stepped-platform regions in new chunks. Requires restart.
naturality.config.feature.end_terrain.to: Generate Naturality's outer End island shapes in new chunks.
Generate Smooth End Stone, Lirestone deposits and custom biome surface materials in new chunks.
naturality.config.feature.lirestone_crag: Select broad Lirestone Crags regions in newly generated End terrain.
naturality.config.feature.end_wilds.tool: Select End Wilds regions with patchy Lyren Heath in new End chunks.
naturality.config.feature.lirestone_boul: Generate Lirestone boulders on outer End islands.
naturality.config.feature.wilds_boulders: Generate large End Stone and Lirestone rock groups in bare areas of End Wilds.
naturality.config.feature.lyren_plants.t: Decorate End Wilds Heath patches with Lyren Sprout and Lyren Growth.
naturality.config.feature.chorus_flowers: Enable oriented flowers, bloom variants, growth, shapes and matching models. Client and server must agree.
Add mature flower crowns to developed chorus tips.
naturality.config.feature.chorus_sprouts: Scatter Chorus Sprouts around newly generated chorus trees.
naturality.config.feature.distortion.too: Enable the Distortion effect's synchronized inversion, ceiling movement and matching camera. Client and server must agree.
naturality.config.feature.confusion.tool: Enable inventory shuffling, mapped inputs and physical offhand exchanges from Confusion.
naturality.config.feature.starfall.toolt: Allow End Starfall weather to spawn falling stars.
Enable farming, fishing, butcher, animal-care and smith work with their tools and animations. Client and server must agree.
naturality.config.feature.villager_bread: Enable evening bread preparation, consumption and pickup behavior.
naturality.config.feature.villager_gates: Let villagers path through, open and close fence gates.
naturality.config.feature.villager_shelt: Let villagers seek shelter during snowy weather.
naturality.config.feature.reputation.too: Enable reputation, village chest ownership, gifts, theft reactions and related commands.
naturality.config.feature.crowd_panic.to: Spread a damage stimulus to nearby members of the same tagged mob species.
naturality.config.feature.fishing_return: Animate reeled-in catches with a server-owned return entity.
naturality.config.feature.weather_cycles: Enable custom rain, wind and temperature cycles and weather commands. Per-world weather values remain controlled by commands.
naturality.config.feature.end_weather.to: Enable the End gravity, Starfall and Rise weather cycle. Per-world values remain controlled by commands.
naturality.config.feature.wind_physics.t: Apply wind forces and displaced foliage collision, selection and climbing shapes.
naturality.config.feature.elytra_momentu: Enable altered elytra acceleration and its related field of view response.
Use fitted snow placement while generating new chunks.
naturality.config.feature.underground_li: Prevent lightning effects from reaching sheltered underground entities.
naturality.config.feature.event_cycles.t: Run and synchronize gameplay events such as Blood Moon, with their commands and spawning changes.
naturality.config.feature.sky_event_cycl: Run and synchronize meteor, rainbow, aurora and End flash events, with their commands.
naturality.config.feature.visual_overhau: Enable optional client rendering and ambience. Content models, status-effect UI and movement cameras remain available.
naturality.config.feature.resource_overr: Use Naturality's general replacement vanilla textures and artwork. Independently enabled particle effects keep their required sprite definitions; content models and required shaders remain available.
naturality.config.feature.end_sky.toolti: Use Naturality's End sky and stars.
naturality.config.feature.sky_events.too: Render synchronized meteors, planets, rainbows, auroras and End flashes.
Muffle rain and wind according to shelter.
naturality.config.feature.underwater_aud: Muffle sound as the listener descends underwater.
naturality.config.feature.lightning.tool: Use custom lightning rendering, visibility and delayed thunder.
naturality.config.feature.pixel_breaking: Use pixel-aligned breaking overlays and block fragments.
naturality.config.feature.sand_particles: Emit particles when sand is placed.
naturality.config.feature.fishing_models: Use the modeled player bobber, simulated line and rod-tip alignment.
naturality.config.feature.mob_arrows.too: Render stuck arrows on supported mobs.
naturality.config.feature.fireball_model: Replace large, small and dragon fireball visuals and smoke trails.
naturality.config.feature.ghast_squash.t: Squash charging ghasts, animate their elastic release and lean moving ghasts and happy ghasts. Ghast physics separately controls falling deaths and rider movement, retaining the body lean required to align riders when enabled.
naturality.config.feature.elytra_cape.to: Apply cape sway to folded elytra wings.
naturality.config.feature.entity_fire.to: Use fitted, procedural entity fire and soul-fire overlays.
naturality.config.feature.fluid_tails.to: Extend falling liquid columns into air with fading tails.
naturality.config.feature.sand_placement: Broadcast sand-placement events from the server for clients with sand particles enabled.
naturality.config.feature.fireball_fire_: Prevent ordinary fireballs from automatically setting themselves on fire. Off retains vanilla server behavior; projectile impacts remain unchanged.
naturality.config.feature.rise_particles: Render the upward-flowing particle field during End Rise weather.
naturality.config.feature.farmer_work.to: Enable Naturality farming, supplies, crop storage and composting behavior.
naturality.config.feature.fisherman_work: Enable villager fishing, caught-item retrieval and fish storage.
naturality.config.feature.butcher_work.t: Enable butcher supplies, breeding, luring and livestock management.
naturality.config.feature.animal_care.to: Enable shepherd shearing and smith animal-care behavior.
naturality.config.feature.blood_moon.too: Ease the moon, night skylight and cloud rim glow toward red during Blood Moon events.
naturality.config.feature.proximity.tool: Show a planet sprite during multi-night Proximity events.
naturality.config.feature.meteors.toolti: Render synchronized meteor showers in the Overworld.
naturality.config.feature.rainbows.toolt: Render synchronized rainbows and their sky blend.
naturality.config.feature.auroras.toolti: Render synchronized Overworld and End auroras.
naturality.config.feature.end_flashes.to: Use synchronized custom End flashes and sounds. Off retains vanilla End flashes.
naturality.config.blocks.tooltip: Use Naturality's Nether portal block appearance.
naturality.config.glow.tooltip: Draw the pixel-aligned glow around Nether portals.
Strength of heat distortion above fire and around lava. Zero skips the effect; 50% is the default. Enable Heat waves to use this strength.
naturality.config.liquids.heatWaves.tool: Distort the scene near lava and above fire. Adjust its strength with Heat wave power.
naturality.config.feature.navigation_ins: Held clocks show day and time; held compasses show coordinates and point toward your personal spawn in this dimension, or its fallback. Lodestones override the compass target.
Give ghasts and happy ghasts falling deaths with held loot until impact, and move happy-ghast rider positions with body lean. Changes synchronized entity data; client and server must agree. Off restores vanilla deaths and rider positions.
naturality.config.feature.arrow_impact_e: Send exact arrow impact locations from the server for attached mob-arrow visuals. Off keeps vanilla arrow behavior and allows the visual fallback.
naturality.config.feature.fireball_impac: Send server impact-face details for surface-aligned fireball explosion particles. Off leaves vanilla explosion behavior unchanged.
naturality.config.feature.mob_death_pixe: Progressively remove texture pixels during ordinary mob deaths. Off preserves the vanilla death appearance.
naturality.config.feature.death_smoke.to: Spawn smoke across the last rendered mob pose and use the animated death-smoke artwork. Off restores vanilla poofs and their placement.
naturality.config.feature.explosion_part: Use the flat animated explosion and delayed camera-facing copy. Fireball impact synchronization can additionally align it to the hit surface.
naturality.config.performance.qualifier: Rough estimate, not a measured average; varies by hardware and scene.
naturality.config.performance.lighting.e: Small per-pixel shading cost; larger resolutions can increase it.
naturality.config.performance.effects.ca: A small overlay with visibility checks near the sun.
naturality.config.performance.feature.gh: A small amount of animation work per visible ghast.
naturality.config.performance.feature.fi: Additional model geometry per visible fireball.
naturality.config.performance.feature.mo: A short-lived shader effect on dying mobs.
naturality.config.performance.feature.ph: Usually a small cost; many simultaneous leads increase it.
naturality.config.performance.clouds.ena: Extra cloud geometry and blending; two layers cost more than one.
naturality.config.performance.feature.pi: Cost increases with visible entities and nearby block shapes.
naturality.config.performance.liquids.wa: Additional water shading; large visible water surfaces cost more.
naturality.config.performance.effects.sn: Dense snow on complex blocks increases geometry and rebuild work.
naturality.config.performance.effects.wo: Extra rendering work for visible enchanted equipment.
naturality.config.performance.effects.we: Heavy rain or snow adds many moving, blended particles.
naturality.config.performance.liquids.he: Copies and warps the scene near heat; resolution and visible heat volumes increase cost.
naturality.config.performance.fog.enable: Additional scene rendering and blending; large resolutions increase cost. Fog culling can offset some of it.
naturality.config.performance.dynamicLig: Moving lights can repeatedly update terrain lighting. Many sources near detailed terrain increase cost substantially.
enchantment.naturality.lethality.desc: Increases attack damage and mace damage from falling.
enchantment.naturality.harvesting.desc: Increases drops from blocks and mobs.
enchantment.minecraft.mending.desc: Uses collected experience to repair the item.
enchantment.minecraft.unbreaking.desc: Reduces the chance of losing durability when used.
enchantment.minecraft.binding_curse.desc: The item cannot be removed from the armor slot until it becomes broken or the player dies.
enchantment.minecraft.vanishing_curse.de: The item disappears when its owner dies.
enchantment.minecraft.fire_protection.de: Reduces fire damage and time spent burning.
enchantment.minecraft.respiration.desc: Extends the time you can breathe underwater.
enchantment.minecraft.aqua_affinity.desc: Removes the underwater mining speed penalty.
enchantment.minecraft.thorns.desc: Can damage attackers when they hit you.
enchantment.minecraft.frost_walker.desc: Freezes nearby water into temporary ice when walking.
enchantment.minecraft.soul_speed.desc: Increases movement speed on soul sand and soul soil.
enchantment.minecraft.bane_of_arthropods: Increases damage against arthropods and slows them.
enchantment.minecraft.knockback.desc: Pushes enemies farther away when hit.
enchantment.minecraft.fire_aspect.desc: Sets targets on fire with melee attacks.
enchantment.minecraft.silk_touch.desc: Lets suitable blocks drop themselves when mined.
enchantment.minecraft.fortune.desc: Increases drops from suitable mined blocks.
enchantment.minecraft.infinity.desc: Fires ordinary arrows without consuming them.
enchantment.minecraft.luck_of_the_sea.de: Improves the chance of fishing up treasure.
enchantment.minecraft.lure.desc: Reduces the wait for a fish to bite.
enchantment.minecraft.loyalty.desc: Returns a thrown trident to its owner.
enchantment.minecraft.impaling.desc: Increases trident damage against aquatic mobs.
enchantment.minecraft.riptide.desc: Propels you with a trident while in water or rain.
enchantment.minecraft.channeling.desc: Calls lightning when a thrown trident hits during a thunderstorm.
enchantment.minecraft.multishot.desc: Fires additional crossbow projectiles per shot.
enchantment.minecraft.piercing.desc: Lets crossbow arrows pass through multiple targets.
enchantment.minecraft.density.desc: Increases mace smash damage gained from falling.
enchantment.minecraft.breach.desc: Reduces the protection of a target's armor against mace attacks.
enchantment.minecraft.wind_burst.desc: Launches you upward after a successful mace smash attack.
enchantment.minecraft.lunge.desc: Propels you forward when using a spear's jab attack.
enchantment.naturality.poverty_curse.des: Reduces drops from blocks and mobs. Drops never go below 1, but higher values are always reduced by 1.
You can only use critical attacks.
+{10 * level}% of damage dealt is reflected back to you.
